about: the inbox has no message, so the trigger emits nothing

reads.note: Gmail Trigger v1 with Simplify off and Download Attachments on, polled once in n8n's manual mode (FIXTURES.md): GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages?maxResults=1 (the node also copies its options downloadAttachments and dataPropertyAttachmentsPrefixName into the query), then GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages/<id>?format=raw; mailparser turns the raw message into the item and each attachment into binary attachment_<n>. The trigger polls through these responses on the n8n side (binary attachments cannot be pinned); the Claude side polls the Gmail connector. The inbox has no message

writeReplies.note: Google Drive v2 (the v1 implementation) upload of binary data: n8n 2.47.7 stores binaries on the filesystem by default, so the binary has an id and the node uses the resumable upload: POST /upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=resumable, PUT the bytes to the Location URL, then PATCH /drive/v3/files/<id>?addParents=1SKdHTnYoBNlnhF_QJ-Zyepy-3-WZkObo&supportsAllDrives=true {mimeType, name, originalFilename}; resolveData is off, so no GET follows

expect.offline: Whether a PDF matches 'payslip' is model-driven (the legacy OpenAI completion's reply is recorded; Is matched needs it to be exactly 'true'). The PDFs are one-page stand-ins whose text pdf.js extracts. Manual-mode polling asks for one message
